headline: Base Clashes Reignite in Weathered Expanse as Mooring Front Surges
war_summary: Since the afternoon report, combat operations have dramatically escalated in Weathered Expanse, where a renewed wave of six strategic base transfers in the last two hours accompanied over four thousand fresh casualties. Mooring County continues to witness relentless fighting, tallying seven additional base exchanges as clashes persist over Gravekeeper's Holdfast and neighboring strongpoints. Along the Stlican Shelf, contested fighting at Fort Hoarfrost and The Pale House has produced fresh turnovers, leaving the hex split with one base in no-man's-land. By contrast, the intense flare-up along the Farranac Coast has cooled noticeably over the past two hours, with casualty rates plummeting following earlier skirmishes around Transient Valley. Intense attrition without territorial movement continues to accelerate sharply in Callahan's Passage and Nevish Line, where both factions endure heavy losses under mounting enlistment pressure. Surrounding sectors such as Stonecradle, Linn of Mercy, and Fisherman's Row remain largely quiet.
